meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能在其容器中使用 Vercel CLI 将 Web 应用部署到 Vercel，并自动注入 Vercel API 凭证。它可执行部署、列出部署、检查身份等操作。
howto.when: 当用户要求把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。技能会检查并配置环境，然后执行相关命令。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
列出我在 Vercel 上所有的部署。
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel ls 查看列表。

say.text: 检查我的 Vercel 登录状态。
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel whoami 验证身份。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Vercel CLI inside its container to deploy web apps to Vercel, with credentials automatically injected via OneCLI. It can run deployments, list them, and verify authentication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to deploy a web application to Vercel, per the skill's description. It then checks prerequisites, configures credentials, and prepares the environment.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Runs vercel deploy with your token.

say_en.text: List all my deployments on Vercel.
say_en.note: Runs vercel ls to show deployments.
